content:
Anya: Heads up 1 1 I'm drafting the 'Flex Bundle' spec (commit + burst + QoS add-on). Need quick alignment on caps, refill, billing flow, and launch gates.

Mike: From infra: we need `max_rps` and a per-tenant token rate limit. Autoscaler needs hard bounds or it oscillates under burst. Also clarify if burst can bypass prefix cache eviction.

Sarah: Sales: customers want a simple line: 'Commit X tokens/month, get Y burst credits (tiered pricing).' They'll want to know refill cadence & whether pilot bursts are unlimited. Pilot unlimited OK if flagged on invoice.

Ben: Finance: baseline per-token price for commit, burst costs = 2.5x base by default. QoS = flat monthly fee. Recommend commit min term (3mo) before steep discounts.

Jordan: Legal: call out whether burst is capacity-guaranteed. If it's best-effort, do NOT promise latency SLA for bursted tokens. Need telemetry / invoice dispute retention (30d minimum). No cross-tenant pooling in Private without explicit consent.

pricing-bot: note: two pilots in Q2 had burst spikes ~+40% above commit baseline. Links: /reports/burst-q2 & /notebooks/burst-analysis.ipynb

Anya: Draft quota schema (for product + billing) - sanity check below (defaults):

-- start snippet --
{
  "tier": "flex",
  "commit_tokens_month": 1000000,
  "burst_credits": 200000,
  "burst_multiplier": 2.5,
  "burst_refill_window_days": 30,
  "softcap_pct": 120,
  "qos_addon": {
    "enabled": false,
    "latency_sla_ms": 300
  }
}
-- end snippet --

Mike: Add `max_rps` (we need it in autoscaler configs). Also make `burst_refill_window_days` configurable per-customer for pilots.

Ben: Add `commit_term_months` so Finance can model revenue recognition / churn impacts.

Sarah: Add UI flag: `pilot_burst_override: true` that shows in Console + invoice line item. Keeps sales clear.

Jordan: Launch gating: need legal-approved T&Cs language for burst & an audit trail for every invoice dispute (30d retention).

Anya: Proposed launch checklist (short):
- Product: quota schema + Console visibility and pilot override toggles
- Infra: enforceable `max_rps` + autoscaler validated at +50% burst
- Finance: final pricing formula + pilot billing path (invoice label)
- Legal: contract snippets + telemetry retention policy
- Sales: 2 pilots signed for 6 weeks

Mike: I'll add a perf test: simulate 3x burst for 2 minutes and validate fallback behavior. I can own that.

Sarah: I have 3 pilot prospects (2 startups, 1 mid-market). I'll get LOIs this week.

Ben: I'll run unit-econ with burst multiplier and commit discounts, share by EOW.

Jordan: I'll draft contract addendum & upload to /legal/templates/burst-addendum.md by Thu.

Anya: Next steps: Mike -> `max_rps` + perf plan; Ben -> finance model; Jordan -> legal snippets; Sarah -> pilot LOIs. I'll collate and update the spec by Monday, then 30m sync. :calendar:

Anya: One quick callout: default `burst_refill_window_days = 30`. If no objections in 24h, we'll set it as default and allow per-customer override. :hourglass:
